source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Setting Team Goals (PDF 130, printed 126).

blocks.text: Mushtarka goals tay karna sab ko kaam ki ek simt (direction) deta hai aur taawun barhata hai. Jab roles aur goals wazeh hon to teamwork bohat aasan aur behtar ho jata hai.

blocks.prompt: Shared goals ka team ko kya faida hai?
blocks.explanation: Sab ko aik simt (direction) milti hai aur cooperation (madad) barhti hai; roles aur goals wazeh hon to teamwork aasan aur behtar ho jati hai.

items: Shared goals: aik simt aur zyada cooperation.
